lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new screens, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for home new screens, as only one test has been completed so far.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured results.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction Modes Spotlight
candidates.change: Redesign the home introduction screen into a spotlight layout featuring interactive preview cards that explain desktop pet actions like hiding, summoning, and voice commands.
candidates.why: The finish step has a low conversion rate of 64.8% and mean time of 5815s. Support received multiple emails regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or interact with the desktop pet.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet lives on your desktop screen. Click to summon, right-click for quick actions, or drag to re-position anytime.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Custom Pet Generation Preview Modal
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet verification screen after photo upload so users can inspect and tweak their pet render before completing adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is 66.2% with a long mean duration of 1017s, and support logs show 3 separate tickets about custom pet renders failing or looking wrong.

new_pet_preview.headline: Review Your Companion Render
new_pet_preview.body: Here is how your companion will appear on your desktop. Confirm if everything looks great!

guard.reason: Adds a new pet render preview screen into the onboarding flow without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has drop-off and 3 support tickets, but new screens in adoption previously yielded negative measured lift (-0.4%).

candidates.title: Account Progress Persistence Warning
candidates.change: Display explicit security and data retention hints on the sign-in screen informing users how logging in preserves their adopted pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again under different accounts or credentials.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your primary account to keep all adopted pets safely synced to this device.
sign_in.body: Connecting your existing account restores all saved companions and custom pet settings automatically.

guard.reason: Adds persistent sign-in guidance and hints on the sign-in screen without violating onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in drop-off; low cost hint implementation.

candidates.title: Background Desktop Initialization Status
candidates.change: Enhance the waiting screen with real-time status messages, animated progress indicators, and time estimates while desktop assets load.
candidates.why: The waiting step (home target) takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, while support received tickets where pets failed to appear on desktop.

waiting.headline: Initializing Desktop Companion Environment
waiting.body: Preparing screen overlay and graphics drivers for seamless desktop pet rendering.

guard.reason: Enhances the waiting screen with progress details and real wait estimations as permitted.

candidates.score_note: Home step has extreme mean duration (2336s) and support tickets; UI info update is moderate risk.

candidates.title: Path Selection Story Scroll Stage
candidates.change: Transform the path selection screen into a dynamic story-scroll layout showcasing companion archetypes with video clips.
candidates.why: Choose path drops to 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating users pause or get distracted without engaging visuals.

choose_path.headline: Choose How You Want to Meet Your Companion
choose_path.body: Select whether to pick from existing species or create a one-of-a-kind custom pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns path selection screen layout while maintaining both adopt and create choices.

candidates.score_note: High mean time on path selection, but no support tickets directly backing layout overhaul.

candidates.title: Certificate Signing Interactive Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into an interactive stage layout with an official seal animation and custom name confirmation.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the second-lowest funnel conversion (66.2%) and users spend over 16 minutes on average completing it.

adoption_certificate.headline: Make It Official
adoption_certificate.body: Sign the official adoption record to bring your companion home to your desktop screen.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.certificate' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'preview'] with an asset:certificate/ asset

candidates.title: Desktop Overlay Calibration Screen
candidates.change: Insert a desktop overlay calibration step right before completing onboarding to test graphics rendering and screen position.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 issues where pets failed to display on desktop or the desktop window did not launch properly, contributing to finish drop-off.

new_desktop_calibration.headline: Testing Desktop Display Layer
new_desktop_calibration.body: We are verifying your display settings to make sure your pet floats smoothly over your windows.

guard.reason: Adds a new desktop calibration step before home intro without dropping any standard onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drop-off is high with 3 tickets, but adding a new screen carries high friction risk.

candidates.title: Path Choice Comfort Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Add a delayed tip carousel on the path choice screen comforting users that their choice can be changed later.
candidates.why: The mean time spent on choose_path is 514s (median 8s), showing extreme outlier delays when users get stuck making a decision.

choose_path.hint: Don't worry! You can add more companions or switch styles anytime after setup.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful delayed tip carousel to the path choice screen without violating design rules.

candidates.score_note: Targets mean duration outlier on choose_path via low-friction hint carousel.

candidates.title: Account Login Assistance Alert
candidates.change: Add a background notification status banner to sign-in screen to assist users if authentication window stalls.
candidates.why: Sign-in screen drops to 72.9% conversion, and 2 support tickets mentioned sign-in screens not appearing or stalling.

sign_in.hint: If the sign-in popup does not open automatically, click below to refresh authentication.

guard.reason: Adds sign-in status and login assistance components to the existing sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drop-off supported by 2 tickets; notification banner is cheap and low risk.

candidates.title: Desktop Environment Readiness Check Flow
candidates.change: Add a diagnostic check screen during the waiting step that verifies display permissions and background process execution.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean duration is 2336s, and support receives tickets regarding pets failing to display on desktop after onboarding.

new_desktop_diagnostic.headline: Verifying System Compatibility
new_desktop_diagnostic.body: Checking system permissions to make sure your companion can move freely around your desktop.

guard.reason: Inserts a diagnostic check screen after waiting while preserving all base onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Home new screens previously showed strong negative lift (-6.6%); adding a flow adds friction.
